findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 17 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 28 questions numbered 1-28; by section: 17.1 2, 17.2 2, 17.5 2, 17.6 2, 17.7 2, 17.8 2, 17.10 2, 17.11 2, 17.12 2, 17.13 2, 17.14 2, 17.16 4, 17.17 2.

14 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering AC characteristics and rms/average values, mean and peak power, AC through R, L (with choke) and C, RC, RL, RLC-series and RLC-parallel circuits, rectification with smoothing, self-induction, energy stored in an inductor and mutual induction; every derivation of the chapter appears. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: capacitor current leads; Vᵣₘₛ = Iᵣₘₛ√(R² + X_L²); average current ½I; energy density B²/2μₒ; I = B/μₒn; apparent power VI; parallel Q rises with R; ripple depends on C; θ = tan⁻¹(1/2πfCR).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
